segments.line: Here's the deal you make with yourself. Five rules, straight from the game.
Rule one: never walk. Always run.
Rule two: anything with wheels is a ride.
Rule three: when you get hurt, eat something, and you're fine.
Rule four: the whole city is your map. Rooftops, fences, backyards. Everywhere.
And rule five, the important one.
If the police come after you, just hide for a while. The stars fade. Everybody forgets.
Your best friend Mo thinks this is the greatest idea anyone has ever had.
'I'll film everything, ' he says. 'This is going to be legendary. '
Your mom doesn't know about any of this. Yet.
In the game, a whole day goes by in less than an hour. In real life, twenty- four hours is a very, very long time.
Twenty- four hours. Five rules. Let's see which one breaks first.
